title: Agent Preset Manager
subtitle: Register agent presets at runtime without editing any DSH configuration file
loadFailed: Could not read the preset list
empty: No preset is managed by this plugin yet. Start by copying any existing preset.

detail.compositionHint: The complete plugin rows this preset declares, shown read-only.
detail.readonlyNote: Built-in and third-party presets can be viewed and copied, but never edited or deleted.

editor.completeHint: Off by default: the persona is added on top of the built-in prompt instead of replacing it.
editor.name: Name
editor.draftShared: The Persona and YAML editors share one draft; switching keeps your changes.
editor.yamlHint: The full plugin composition, preserving the DSH YAML dialect, !!js expressions, and unknown fields.
editor.personaMissing: This preset has no persona row; filling any field adds one.

history.title: History
history.empty: No history yet. Revisions appear here after you save a change.
history.restoreWarning: Restoring registers that revision as current; the current one is archived first.

clone.title: Copy preset
clone.newIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens only.
clone.name: Display name

share.title: Export and share
share.risks: The following may need review before sharing
share.noRisks: No obvious secrets or local paths were detected.
share.copyFailed: Copy failed; select and copy the text below manually

import.title: Import preset
import.clipboardFailed: Could not read the clipboard; paste the text manually
import.mustAcknowledge: I have reviewed the risks above and confirm the import
import.idConflictHint: That ID is taken; use the suggested ID below.
import.blockedMissing: A required plugin package is missing; this preset would not activate
import.nothingApplied: Preview writes no file and registers no preset.

delete.title: Delete preset
delete.confirm: Delete the preset "{id}"? The final revision stays available in history.
delete.defaultRisk: This plugin never changes DSH's own default-preset setting. After deletion a new session may reference a preset that no longer exists; set the default back to a built-in preset in DSH settings.
delete.defaultRiskConfirm: I understand and still want to delete it

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.quarantine: A preset file could not be parsed and was quarantined
diagnostics.degraded: Some presets did not load correctly

purge.title: Clear all plugin data
purge.warning: This deletes every preset, history entry, and metadata file under this plugin's data directory. It cannot be undone (a backup is written first).
purge.instruction: Type DELETE ALL PRESET DATA to confirm

defaultNote.title: About the default preset
defaultNote.body: This plugin never modifies the default preset DSH persists. You can pick a preset registered here with DSH's own selector; if you make one the default, set it back to a built-in preset before deleting it.

meta.title: Agent Preset Manager
meta.description: Register and manage agent presets at runtime without editing any DSH configuration file
